units.en: He restored fallen music and raised extinct rites; Confucian halls were repaired and barbarian posts stood empty.
units.literal: He restored collapsed music, again raised extinct rites; Confucian halls were repaired, barbarian posts stood empty of scouts.

units.zh: 雖大功在舜，盛績維禹，巍巍蕩蕩，無得而稱。
units.en: Though his merit matched Shun and his achievement only Yu, he was vast beyond naming.
units.literal: Though great merit lay in Shun and splendid achievement only in Yu, vast, vast—none could name it.

units.zh: 來獻白環，豈直皇虞之世；
units.en: White rings came as tribute—was that only in the age of august Yu?
units.literal: White rings came as tribute—was it only in the age of august Yu?

units.zh: 入貢素雉，非止隆周之日。
units.en: White pheasants were offered—not only in exalted Zhou.
units.literal: White pheasants entered tribute—not only on the exalted Zhou day.

units.zh: 故效珍川陸，表瑞煙雲，玉露醴泉，旦夕凝涌，嘉禾瑞草，孳植郊甸，道昭于悠代，勛格於皇穹。
units.en: Treasures rose from rivers and land, omens from mist and cloud; sweet dew and sweet springs welled morning and evening; fine grain and auspicious grass sprouted thick in the suburbs; the Way shone in distant ages and merit reached heaven.
units.literal: Thus treasures were offered on rivers and land, omens shown in mist and cloud; sweet dew and sweet springs morning and evening welled and surged; fine grain and auspicious grass sprouted thick in the suburbs; the Way was clear in distant ages, merit reached the august vault.

units.zh: 明明上天，光華日月，革故著于玄象，代德彰于讖圖，獄訟有違，謳歌爰適，天之曆數，實有攸在。
units.en: Bright was high heaven, glory to sun and moon; change of the old was written in the dark signs, succession of virtue in the charts; lawsuits found their judge, songs of praise turned here—the heavenly succession truly had its lord.
units.literal: Bright, bright was high heaven, glory to sun and moon; change of the old was written in the dark signs, succession of virtue shown in the charts; lawsuits had their turn, songs of praise turned this way—the heavenly succession truly had its place.

units.zh: 朕雖庸藐，暗于古昔，永稽崇替，爲日已久，敢忘列代之遺典，人祇之至願乎！
units.en: Though I am mediocre and small, dark on antiquity, long have I traced rise and fall; how dare I forget the former dynasties' statutes and the utmost wish of men and spirits!
units.literal: Though I am mediocre and small, dark on antiquity, long have I traced exaltation and replacement; how dare I forget the former dynasties' handed statutes and the utmost wish of men and spirits!

units.zh: 史臣曰：梁季橫潰，喪亂屢臻，當此之時，天歷去矣，敬皇高讓，將同釋負焉。
units.en: The historiographer says: When the Liang age collapsed, calamity followed calamity; Heaven's mandate had departed; Emperor Jing's high abdication was like laying down a burden.
units.literal: The historiographer says: When the Liang age collapsed in ruin, calamities and disorder came one after another; at this time Heaven's mandate had departed; Emperor Jing's high abdication was about to be like laying down a burden.

units.zh: 眾好學，頗有文詞，起家梁鎮衛南平王法曹參軍、太子舍人。
units.en: Zhong loved study and wrote well. He entered service as registrar to the Prince of Nanping of the garrison guard and as household retainer to the heir apparent.
units.literal: Zhong loved learning and had considerable literary skill; he began his career as Registrar to the Prince of Nanping of the Garrison Guard and Household Retainer to the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 梁蕭繹為周軍所逼，遣使告急，且請援。
units.en: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys begging aid.
units.literal: Xiao Yi of Liang, pressed by Zhou armies, sent envoys reporting emergency and requesting aid.

units.zh: 冬，詔岳為西南道大行臺，統司徒潘相樂等救江陵。
units.en: In winter an edict made Yue grand field headquarters of the southwest circuit, commanding minister of state Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.
units.literal: In winter an edict made Yue Grand Field Headquarters of the Southwest Circuit, commanding Minister of State Pan Xiangyue and others to rescue Jiangling.

units.zh: 及為右僕射，又說後主禁屠宰，斷酤酒。
units.en: When he was right vice minister, he again persuaded the Last Emperor to forbid slaughter and cut off the sale of wine.
units.literal: When he was Right Vice Minister, he again persuaded the Last Emperor to forbid slaughter and cut off the sale of wine.

units.zh: 後主時，斫骨光弁奉使至州，思好迎之甚謹，光弁倨敖，思好因心銜恨。
units.en: Under the Later Lord, Zhuogu Guangbian came to the province on mission. Sihao received him with scrupulous courtesy; Guangbian repaid him with arrogance — and Sihao nursed the insult in silence.
units.literal: In the time of the Later Lord, Zhuogu Guangbian came on mission to the province; Sihao received him with great courtesy, but Guangbian was arrogant and haughty — Sihao therefore nursed resentment in his heart.

units.zh: 後主奔鄴，就加太宰。
units.en: When the Later Lord fled to Ye, Pu was additionally made grand preceptor.
units.literal: When the Later Lord fled to Ye, Pu was additionally made Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 與懷朔省事雲中司馬子如及秀容人劉貴、中山人賈顯智為奔走之友，懷朔戶曹史孫騰、外兵史侯景亦相友結。
units.en: He made running companions of Sima Ziru, affairs clerk at Huaishuo's Yunzhong desk, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan; Sun Teng, the garrison household clerk, and Hou Jing, clerk for external military affairs, joined their circle as well.
units.literal: With Sima Ziru, affairs clerk of Yunzhong at Huaishuo, Liu Gui of Xiurong, and Jia Xianzhi of Zhongshan he formed a band of comrades ready to run errands; Sun Teng, household clerk at Huaishuo, and Hou Jing, clerk in external military affairs, also joined in friendship.

units.zh: 庚戌，以寧朔將軍蕭懿爲梁、南秦二州刺史，輔國長史申希祖爲交州刺史。
units.en: Day gengxu: Xiao Yi, pacifying-barbarians general, took Liang and South Qin; Shen Xizu, supporter-of-the-state chief clerk, took Jiaozhou.
units.literal: Day gengxu: Pacifying-Barbarians General Xiao Yi was made inspector of Liang and South Qin; Supporter-of-the-State Chief Clerk Shen Xizu was made inspector of Jiaozhou.

units.zh: 又陳武帝率衆將攻廣陵，刺史王敬寶遣使告急；
units.en: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;
units.literal: Chen Baxian was also leading a host of generals to attack Guangling; Governor Wang Jingbao sent envoys in urgent appeal;

units.zh: 霸先等智小謀大，政令未一，外託同德，內有離心，諸君不足憂，吾揣之熟悉矣。」
units.en: Chen Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly."
units.literal: Baxian and the like have small minds and large ambitions; their orders are not unified — outwardly claiming unity, inwardly divided at heart. You need not worry, gentlemen; I know them thoroughly."

units.zh: 謂諸將士曰：「吳人輕躁，本無大謀，今破超達，霸先必走。」
units.en: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Chen Baxian will surely flee."
units.literal: He told the officers and soldiers, "The Wu people are rash by nature and never had great plans. Now that Chaoda is broken, Baxian will surely flee."

units.zh: 陳武帝果遁去。
units.en: Chen Baxian indeed fled.
units.literal: Chen Baxian indeed fled.

units.zh: 五年二月，詔徵韶討之。
units.en: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.
units.literal: In the second month of the fifth year an edict summoned Shao to suppress them.

units.zh: 韶謂諸將曰：「自梁氏喪亂，國無定主，人懷去就，強者從之。
units.en: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.
units.literal: Shao said to the generals, "Since the Liang house fell into disorder, the state has had no fixed ruler; people weigh where to go and where to stay, following whichever side seems stronger.

units.zh: 即回赴廣陵。
units.en: He at once turned back toward Guangling.
units.literal: He at once turned back toward Guangling.

units.zh: 侯景降，詔鴉仁督士州刺史桓和之、仁州刺史湛海珍等精兵三萬，趨懸瓠應接景，仍爲都督豫司淮冀殷應西豫等七州諸軍事、司豫二州刺史，鎮懸瓠。
units.en: When Hou Jing submitted, Yaren was told to lead Huan Hezhi of Shizhou, Zhan Haizhen of Renzhou, and thirty thousand picked men to Xuanhu to meet Jing—and to command seven provinces from Yu to Western Yu as Si-Yu inspector, based at Xuanhu.
units.literal: When Hou Jing surrendered, an edict ordered Yaren to supervise Huan Hezhi, Inspector of Shizhou, Zhan Haizhen, Inspector of Renzhou, and others with thirty thousand elite troops to hurry to Xuanhu to link with Jing; he also served as Area Commander of all military affairs for the seven provinces of Yu, Si, Huai, Ji, Yin, Ying, and Western Yu, and as Inspector of Si and Yu provinces, stationed at Xuanhu.

units.zh: 散騎常侍徐之才、館客宋景業先為天文圖讖之學，又陳山提家客楊子術有所援引，並因德政勸顯祖行禪代之事。
units.en: Regular attendant Xu Zhicai and retainer Song Jingye were versed first in astronomy and apocrypha; also Chen Shanti's household retainer Yang Zishu had connections—all through Dezheng urged Gao Yang to carry out the abdication and succession.
units.literal: Regular attendant Xu Zhicai and retainer Song Jingye were versed first in astronomy and apocrypha; also Chen Shanti's household retainer Yang Zishu had connections—all through Dezheng urged Gao Yang to carry out the abdication and succession.

units.zh: 徐之才、宋景業等每言卜筮雜占陰陽緯侯，必宜五月應天順人，德政亦勸不已。
units.en: Xu Zhicai, Song Jingye, and others kept speaking of divination, mixed auguries, yin and yang, and omens in the weft-texts — that May was the time to answer Heaven and win men; Dezheng urged on without pause.
units.literal: Xu Zhicai, Song Jingye, and others constantly spoke of divination, miscellaneous auguries, yin and yang, and the weft-texts of omens — that May was surely the time to answer Heaven and accord with men; Dezheng too urged without cease.

units.zh: 崔暹，字季倫，博陵安平人，漢尚書寔之後也，世為北州著姓。
units.en: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han minister of works, and for generations a leading house of the northern provinces.
units.literal: Cui Xian, styled Jilun, was a man of Anping in Boling commandery, a descendant of Cui Shi, Han Minister of Works, and for generations a prominent clan of the northern provinces.

units.zh: 僕射徐勉、左率周舍、家令陸襄並同孝綽議。
units.en: Vice Director Xu Mian, Left Leader Zhou She, and Household Intendant Lu Xiang all sided with Xiaochuo.
units.literal: Vice Director Xu Mian, Left Leader Zhou She, and Household Intendant Lu Xiang all agreed with Xiaochuo's deliberation.

units.zh: 以晉昌王唐邕為宰輔，齊昌王莫多婁敬顯、沭陽王和阿于子、右纫大將軍段暢、武纫將軍相里僧伽、開府韓骨胡、侯莫陳洛州為爪牙。
units.en: He made Prince Tang Yong of Jinchang chief minister; Prince Moduolou Jingxian of Qichang; Prince Ah-Yuzi of Shuyang; Right Guard General Duan Chang; Martial Guard General Xiangli Sengqie; Opening-Office General Han Guhu; and Houmochen Luozhou his strong arms.
units.literal: He appointed Prince Tang Yong of Jinchang as chief minister; Prince Moduolou Jingxian of Qichang; Prince Ah-Yuzi of Shuyang; Right Guard General Duan Chang; Martial Guard General Xiangli Sengqie; General of Opening Gates Han Guhu; and Houmochen Luozhou as his strong arms.

units.zh: 子瑞妻，令萱之妹，及令萱得寵於後主，重贈子瑞懷州剌史，諸子亦並居顯職。
units.en: Zirui’s wife was Lu Lingxuan’s younger sister. Once Lingxuan won the Later Sovereign’s favor, Zirui was again posthumously appointed Governor of Huaizhou, and all his sons rose to eminent posts.
units.literal: Zirui’s wife was Lingxuan’s younger sister; when Lingxuan won the Later Sovereign’s favor, Zirui was again posthumously appointed Governor of Huaizhou, and his sons likewise all rose to eminent posts.

units.zh: 邙山之役，大獲俘虜，高祖令纂部送京師，魏帝賜絹五百疋，封武安縣伯。
units.en: At Mount Mang the army took many prisoners. Gao Huan ordered Zuan to escort them to the capital. The Wei emperor bestowed five hundred bolts of silk and enfeoffed him baron of Wu'an County.
units.literal: At the battle of Mount Mang there was a great capture of prisoners; the Grand Ancestor ordered Zuan to escort them to the capital; the Wei emperor bestowed five hundred bolts of silk and enfeoffed him Baron of Wu'an County.

units.zh: 神武明皇后婁氏，諱昭君，贈司徒內干之女也。
units.en: Empress Ming, née Lou, whose personal name was Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Empress Ming, Lady Lou, taboo name Zhaojun, was the daughter of Neigan, posthumously appointed Minister of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 神武婁后
units.en: Empress Lou of Shenwu
units.literal: Empress Lou of Shenwu

units.zh: 及拜渤海王妃，閫闈之事悉決焉。
units.en: When she was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.
units.literal: When he was enfeoffed Princess Consort of Bohai, all affairs of the inner quarters were decided by her.

units.zh: 文襄嗣位，進為太妃。
units.en: When Gao Cheng succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.
units.literal: When Wenxiang succeeded to the throne, she was advanced to Grand Consort.

units.zh: 天保初，尊為皇太后，宮曰宣訓。
units.en: At the opening of the Tianbao era, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, she was honored as Empress Dowager; her palace was named Xuanxun.

units.zh: 孝昭即位，復為皇太后。
units.en: When Gao Yan succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When Xiaozhao succeeded, she again became Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 濟南即位，尊為太皇太后。
units.en: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.
units.literal: When the Emperor of Jinan succeeded, she was honored as Grand Empress Dowager.

units.zh: 太皇太后密與孝昭及諸大將定策誅之，下令廢立。
units.en: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Gao Yan and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing one ruler and enthroning another.
units.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager secretly joined Xiaozhao and the great generals in fixing a plan to execute them, and issued an edict deposing and enthroning.

units.zh: 大寧二年春，太后寢疾，衣忽自舉，用巫媼言改姓石氏。
units.en: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.
units.literal: In the spring of the second year of Daning, the empress dowager fell ill; her garments suddenly lifted of themselves, and following a sorceress's words she changed her surname to Shi.

units.zh: 孝昭帝崩，太后又下詔立武成帝。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaozhao died, the empress dowager again issued an edict enthroning Emperor Wucheng.

units.zh: 及見神武於城上執役，驚曰：「此真吾夫也。」
units.en: When she saw Gao Huan laboring on the city wall, she started and said, "This is truly my husband."
units.literal: When she saw Shenwu performing labor on the city wall, she was startled and said: "This is truly my husband."

units.zh: 乃使婢通意，又數致私財，使以聘己，父母不得已而許焉。
units.en: She sent a maid to convey her feelings and repeatedly sent private funds so that he might betroth her; her parents, having no choice, consented.
units.literal: She then sent a maid to convey her feelings, and repeatedly sent private funds so that he might betroth her; her parents, having no choice, consented.

units.zh: 弟昭，以功名自達，其餘親屬，未嘗為請爵位。
units.en: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.
units.literal: Her younger brother Zhao attained distinction through merit; as for the rest of her kin, she never once asked for noble rank on their behalf.

units.zh: 太后凡孕六男二女，皆感夢：孕文襄則夢一斷龍；
units.en: The empress dowager in all bore six sons and two daughters, each pregnancy attended by a dream: when she conceived Gao Cheng she dreamed of a severed dragon;
units.literal: The empress dowager in all bore six sons and two daughters, each pregnancy attended by a dream: when she conceived Wenxiang she dreamed of a severed dragon;

units.zh: 孕文宣則夢大龍，首尾屬天地，張口動目，勢狀驚人；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Yang she dreamed of a great dragon whose head and tail joined heaven and earth, mouth open and eyes moving, its aspect terrifying;
units.literal: when she conceived Wenxuan she dreamed of a great dragon whose head and tail joined heaven and earth, mouth open and eyes moving, its aspect terrifying;

units.zh: 孕孝昭則夢蠕龍於地；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Yan she dreamed of a writhing dragon upon the ground;
units.literal: when she conceived Xiaozhao she dreamed of a writhing dragon upon the ground;

units.zh: 孕武成則夢龍浴於海；
units.en: when she conceived Gao Zhan she dreamed of a dragon bathing in the sea;
units.literal: when she conceived Wucheng she dreamed of a dragon bathing in the sea;

units.zh: 孕魏二后並夢月入懷；
units.en: when she conceived the two Wei empresses she both dreamed of the moon entering the bosom;
units.literal: when she conceived the two Wei empresses she both dreamed of the moon entering the bosom;

units.zh: 孕襄城、博陵二王夢鼠入衣下。
units.en: when she conceived the Princes of Xiangcheng and Boling she dreamed of rats entering beneath the garments.
units.literal: when she conceived the Princes of Xiangcheng and Boling she dreamed of rats entering beneath the garments.

units.zh: 四月辛丑，崩於北宮，時年六十二。
units.en: On the xinchou day of the fourth month she died at the Northern Palace, aged sixty-two.
units.literal: On the xinchou day of the fourth month she died at the Northern Palace, aged sixty-two.

units.zh: 五月甲申，合葬義平陵。
units.en: On the jiashen day of the fifth month she was interred with Gao Huan at Yiping Tomb.
units.literal: On the jiashen day of the fifth month she was interred with Shenwu at Yiping Tomb.

units.zh: 文宣將受魏禪，后固執不許，帝所以中止。
units.en: When Gao Yang was about to receive the Wei abdication, the empress firmly refused to permit it, and the emperor therefore desisted.
units.literal: When Wenxuan was about to receive the Wei abdication, the empress firmly refused to permit it, and the emperor therefore desisted.

units.zh: 神武嘗將西討出師，後夜孿生一男一女，左右以危急，請追告神武。
units.en: Once, as Gao Huan was about to march west on campaign, the empress gave birth at night to twins, a boy and a girl. Those beside her, finding the situation perilous, asked to send word after him.
units.literal: Once when Shenwu was about to march west on campaign, the empress at night bore twins, a boy and a girl; those beside her, finding the situation perilous, asked to send word after Shenwu.

units.zh: 后弗聽曰：「王出統大兵，何得以我故輕離軍幕。
units.en: The empress would not hear of it. "The king has gone forth to command a great army," she said. "He cannot lightly leave the command tent on my account.
units.literal: The empress would not listen and said: "The king has gone forth to command a great army — how can he lightly leave the command tent on my account.

units.zh: 死生命也，來復何為！」
units.en: Life and death are fate — what use is it if he comes back!"
units.literal: Life and death are fate — what use is it if he comes back!"

units.zh: 沙苑敗後，侯景屢言請精騎二萬，必能取之。
units.en: After the defeat at Shaya, Hou Jing repeatedly asked for twenty thousand picked cavalry, saying he could certainly recover the lost ground.
units.literal: After the defeat at Shaya, Hou Jing repeatedly asked for twenty thousand picked cavalry, saying he could certainly recover it.

units.zh: 神武悅，以告于后。
units.en: Gao Huan was pleased and told the empress.
units.literal: Shenwu was pleased and told the empress.

units.zh: 后曰：「若如其言，豈有還理，得獺失景，亦有何利。」
units.en: The empress said, "If things go as he promises, there would be no reason for him to return. You would gain some paltry conquest and lose Hou Jing; there would be no profit in that."
units.literal: The empress said: "If it comes about as he says, could there be any coming back — gain the otter, lose Jing; what profit is there."

units.zh: 乃止。
units.en: Thereupon he desisted.
units.literal: Thereupon he desisted.

units.zh: 及茹茹公主至，后避正室處之。
units.en: When the Rouran princess arrived, the empress vacated the main chamber to lodge her.
units.literal: When the Rouran princess arrived, the empress vacated the main chamber to lodge her.

units.zh: 后曰：「國家大計，願不疑也。」
units.en: The empress said, "This is a great plan for the state — do not hesitate."
units.literal: The empress said: "This is a great plan for the state — do not hesitate."

units.zh: 性寬厚，不妒忌，神武姬侍，咸加恩待。
units.en: Her nature was generous and free of jealousy; Gao Huan's concubines and attendants she treated with equal favor.
units.literal: Her nature was generous and she was not jealous; Shenwu's concubines and attendants she all treated with favor.

units.zh: 后高明嚴斷，雅遵儉約，往來外舍，侍從不過十人。
units.en: The empress was lofty in judgment, clear-minded, and stern; she always observed thrift, and when she went out to external residences her attendants never exceeded ten.
units.literal: The empress was lofty, clear, and stern in judgment; she always observed thrift; when going out to external residences, her attendants never exceeded ten.

units.zh: 神武既有澄清之志，傾產以結英豪，密謀秘策，后恒參預。
units.en: Once Gao Huan resolved to restore order, he spent his estate to win over heroes; in secret plots and hidden stratagems Empress Lou always took part.
units.literal: Once Shenwu had the will to restore order, he spent his estate to win over heroes; in secret plots and hidden stratagems the empress always took part.

units.zh: 后未崩，有童謠曰「九龍母死不作孝」。
units.en: Before the empress dowager died, a children's rhyme ran: "Nine dragons — when the mother dies, no mourning."
units.literal: Before the empress dowager died, a children's rhyme said: "Nine dragons — when the mother dies, no mourning."

units.zh: 及后崩，武成不改服，緋袍如故。
units.en: When the empress dowager died, Wucheng did not change his garments and kept his crimson robe as before.
units.literal: When the empress dowager died, Wucheng did not change his garments and kept his crimson robe as before.

units.zh: 論曰：神武肇興齊業，武明追蹤周亂。
units.en: The appraisal says: Shenwu founded Qi's enterprise, but Wuming followed the path of Zhou's disorder.
units.literal: The appraisal says: Shenwu first raised the enterprise of Qi, but Wuming followed the track of Zhou's disorder.

units.zh: 乙卯，司空陳霸先授衆軍節度，與齊軍交戰，大破之，斬齊北兗州刺史杜方慶及徐嗣徽、弟嗣宗，生擒徐嗣產、蕭軌、東方老、王敬寶、李希光、裴英起、劉歸義等，皆誅之。
units.en: On yimao Minister of Works Chen Baxian took command of the armies, met the Qi force, and won a great victory; he beheaded Qi's North Yanzhou inspector Du Fangqing, Xu Sihui, and Sihui's brother Sizong; he captured Xu Sichan, Xiao Gui, Dongfang Lao, Wang Jingbao, Li Xiguang, Pei Yingqi, Liu Guiyi, and others alive and executed them all.
units.literal: On yimao Minister of Works Chen Baxian conferred command tokens on the massed armies and joined battle with Qi troops, greatly defeating them; beheaded Qi North Yanzhou Inspector Du Fangqing and Xu Sihui and his younger brother Sizong; captured alive Xu Sichan, Xiao Gui, Dongfang Lao, Wang Jingbao, Li Xiguang, Pei Yingqi, Liu Guiyi, and others—all were executed.
